description: I maintain and develop client websites on Sitefinity, WordPress, Drupal and SharePoint, and I build and optimise email campaigns (EDMs) in Stripo.
Front-end development: I turned designs into clean, responsive HTML and fixed UI/UX issues. I also managed content, QA and maintenance on Sitefinity and Drupal sites.

I built custom e-commerce sites with Laravel, Jetstream, Livewire, Tailwind and Alpine: authentication, product catalogues, carts and order management. I also made a custom Tailwind WordPress theme and worked directly with clients on their requirements.
